verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an online government e-services portal, but the evidence shows no bulk data export, open-format download, or account-exit workflow. Being able to print returns and reports, or view notices, is a related feature rather than an export of all your data in open formats. Probes found no API or machine-readable endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
